scope: Governed integration contract for every Sync Context capability discussed in the original God's Eye review and represented by the standalone prototype. This ledger does not import or approve upstream source code.

sourceCatalog.authority: Prototype author claims; not production proof
Prototype capability and production-boundary claims; not main-repository proof

sourceCatalog.locator: This repository at the pinned commit under review
sourceCatalog.authority: Canonical implementation and automated contract evidence

provenanceAnchors.AGENTS.md:definition-of-done: AGENTS.md, Definition of done and Capability register sections

statusDefinitions.existing_foundation: Main contains a relevant canonical, tenant-scoped foundation, but this does not mean the full Sync Context capability is complete.
statusDefinitions.prototype_only: The standalone prototype reports the capability as playable or contracted; main does not contain production-grade implementation evidence.
statusDefinitions.missing: The review requires the capability and neither main nor the prototype provides adequate implementation evidence.
statusDefinitions.external_dependency: Delivery depends on a provider, customer system, credential, legal approval, certified system, or physical sensor outside this repository.

completionDefinitions.not_started: No main-repository implementation evidence for the complete requirement.
completionDefinitions.partial: Some canonical foundation exists, but one or more acceptance conditions remain unproved.
completionDefinitions.complete: Every acceptance condition has current main-repository evidence and named automated verification.

implementationSequence.title: Governed scope contract
implementationSequence.scope: Land this ledger, provenance, explicit constraints, checker and accepted baseline only.
exitEvidence: No God's Eye source code is imported

implementationSequence.title: Canonical context contracts
implementationSequence.scope: Extend canonical assets, evidence and events with source-independent spatial, temporal, health and licensing contracts; do not introduce parallel asset, evidence, recommendation, approval or audit stores.

implementationSequence.title: Governed 2D operating picture
implementationSequence.scope: Deliver the first customer-reachable 2D map over verified canonical geospatial features, source health and an industrial inspector.

implementationSequence.title: 3D shell and layer runtime
implementationSequence.scope: Add the optional 3D globe, shared 2D/3D state, isolated layer failures, display modes and responsive operational shell.

implementationSequence.title: Honest deterministic demo
implementationSequence.scope: Add clearly labeled synthetic industrial objects and deterministic scenarios without random sales-critical values or claims of customer connectivity.
exitEvidence: No overwrite of connected customer telemetry

implementationSequence.title: Approved external context
implementationSequence.scope: Add public context sources one provider at a time behind server-governed adapters after terms, attribution, caching, quota and production-use review.

implementationSequence.title: Investigation evidence and replay
implementationSequence.scope: Extend canonical evidence with governed media metadata, clock integrity, bookmarks and synchronized replay; no parallel evidence store.

implementationSequence.title: Spatial safety assurance
implementationSequence.scope: Combine canonical permits, barriers, work, temporary conditions and observations as decision support while certified systems and humans retain authority.

implementationSequence.title: Context-aware voice controls
implementationSequence.scope: Extend the existing governed Realtime boundary with bounded map controls and audited tenant-scoped context; never expose arbitrary execution or approval.

implementationSequence.title: Customer operational connectors
implementationSequence.scope: Replace demo adapters with tenant-scoped historian, CMMS/EAM, fleet, GIS, VMS, permit, access and project connectors without changing UI contracts.

implementationSequence.title: Production hardening and learning
implementationSequence.scope: Complete PostGIS scale, durable replay, degraded/offline behavior, source conflict handling, recurring-condition analytics, retention and production verification.

capabilities.title: UI accelerator, not platform fork
capabilities.requirement: Treat the God's Eye work only as a visual and interaction reference; native Sync architecture owns backend, data, governance, permissions, evidence and decisions.
capabilities.gap: No God's Eye source is integrated in main; future UI work must conform to this ledger.
acceptance: No copied God's Eye implementation enters this contract PR
Every later slice reuses canonical main models

capabilities.title: Preserve immediacy, replace semantics
capabilities.requirement: Preserve the fast operational command-center interaction model while replacing military, conflict and surveillance semantics with industrial operations.
capabilities.gap: Main has an industrial shell but no equivalent spatial operating experience.
acceptance: Industrial terminology throughout reachable UI
Military and conflict layers disabled by construction

capabilities.title: Industrial control-room language
capabilities.requirement: Use graphite or dark-slate surfaces with restrained cyan, amber and red state cues, technical typography and restrained animation rather than tactical or sci-fi language.
capabilities.gap: A main-product spatial design system and accessibility evidence are absent.
acceptance: Approved design tokens
WCAG contrast and reduced-motion checks

capabilities.title: No military or conflict defaults
capabilities.requirement: Military, tactical, conflict and war layers and branding must not be active Sync defaults or be restored by upstream changes.
capabilities.gap: Main has no upstream-sync guard because no fork is integrated; a future spatial runtime needs an explicit denylist contract.
acceptance: Automated denylist test covers names, defaults and routes
Upstream update checklist blocks reintroduction

capabilities.title: Canonical model reuse
capabilities.requirement: Extend canonical assets, sites, work, evidence, recommendations, decisions, approvals, risks, recovery, projects and audit instead of duplicating them for spatial context.
capabilities.gap: SC-01 canonical identity mapping, tenant enforcement and approval/work relationship checks are delivered; later adapters must extend these links rather than introduce stores.
acceptance: Contract test forbids parallel asset, work, evidence, recommendation, approval and audit stores
Every spatial link carries tenant and canonical subject identity

capabilities.title: Tenant isolation
capabilities.requirement: Every persisted object, query, media reference, stream and tool call is organization-scoped and protected by server-authoritative tenant checks and RLS.
capabilities.gap: Canonical SC-01 sources, projections and writes are isolated; later media, feed, replay and tool surfaces still require their own tenant tests.
acceptance: Foreign-tenant reads and writes fail for every Context table and RPC
Service-role paths revalidate user and organization

capabilities.title: Canonical evidence provenance
capabilities.requirement: Every material observation, context assessment, recommendation and replay bookmark links to the one canonical evidence model with source, time, authority, quality and gaps.
capabilities.gap: Media bookmarks and synchronized replay do not yet land on canonical evidence_items.
acceptance: No parallel evidence table
Every saved bookmark has source, timestamps and canonical evidence linkage

capabilities.title: Human approval remains authoritative
capabilities.requirement: Context and AI may observe, summarize, flag, draft and recommend; only authorized humans and existing approval policy may authorize work, permits, safety decisions, corrective actions or operational changes.
capabilities.gap: SC-01 is read-only context with visible authority labels; later action surfaces still need explicit handoff tests to canonical approval paths.
acceptance: No Context RPC can approve or release work
UI distinguishes draft, recommended, approved and executed

capabilities.title: No invented operational data
capabilities.requirement: Never invent coordinates, telemetry, thresholds, limits, source health, customer connectivity, causality or approvals; missing or simulated values remain explicit.
capabilities.gap: SC-01 preserves unknown values, prevents simulated sources from presenting as live, and rejects unverified engineering claims. A canonical server projection that verifies every engineering limit against approved evidence is still missing, and later media and analytic adapters must pass the same no-invention contract.
acceptance: Unknown is represented as unknown
Simulated values cannot be relabeled live or customer operational
Engineering limits require approved evidence

capabilities.title: Non-surveillance purpose
capabilities.requirement: Video and positioning support unsafe-condition understanding, prevention, response and learning; they do not become a worker-surveillance or blame product.
capabilities.gap: Main has no video-purpose policy or enforcement surface.
acceptance: Purpose, access and retention are policy-enforced
Worker identity is excluded from default models and analytics

capabilities.title: Computer vision creates observations, not verdicts
capabilities.requirement: Machine vision may draft a SafetyObservation with evidence and confidence but may not assert causality, guilt, permit cancellation or a safety verdict.
externalDependencies: Approved vision model and site policy
capabilities.gap: No canonical SafetyObservation workflow exists in main.
acceptance: Observation schema separates detected condition from human disposition
Automated tests reject verdict and authorization outputs

capabilities.title: No facial recognition
capabilities.requirement: Facial recognition is prohibited as a default Sync Context capability.
capabilities.gap: No automated Context feature denylist exists in main.
acceptance: Schema and API expose no biometric identity field or tool
Denylist contract fails on facial-recognition capability introduction

capabilities.title: No individual productivity scoring
capabilities.requirement: Individual productivity tracking, continuous employee scoring and identity-based PPE enforcement are prohibited defaults.
capabilities.gap: No automated Context analytics denylist exists in main.
acceptance: Only aggregate or anonymous zone occupancy is allowed by default
Tests reject worker score and productivity fields

capabilities.title: Third-party terms are independent
capabilities.requirement: Treat each external feed's access, attribution, commercial use, quota, caching and redistribution terms separately from the upstream Apache-2.0 code license.
capabilities.gap: The main inventory does not yet hold provider-by-provider data-rights decisions.
acceptance: Every enabled source has dated terms, attribution, cache, quota and production-use decisions
Unapproved sources fail closed

capabilities.title: Public media and customer VMS separation
capabilities.requirement: Public demo cameras and customer VMS footage are separate source classes, credentials, authorization paths, retention rules and UI labels.
capabilities.gap: No camera or VMS connector exists in main.
acceptance: Credentials and records cannot cross source classes
Customer footage requires tenant and source-level authorization

capabilities.title: SpatialObject contract
capabilities.requirement: Normalize fixed, mobile, human-zone and contextual objects through a source-independent SpatialObject linked to canonical Sync identities rather than copying them.
capabilities.gap: The SC-01 SpatialObject envelope projects only verified, current features with at least one canonical subject; draft-before-link records remain outside normalized Context until governed linking succeeds.
acceptance: Object carries tenant, canonical subject, geometry, source class, authority, observed time, freshness and evidence
Adapters cannot invent canonical identities

capabilities.title: ContextEvent contract
capabilities.requirement: Normalize failures, alarms, work, hazards, movements and external events through a source-independent ContextEvent linked to canonical records.
canonicalReuse: canonical event, work, recommendation and audit records
capabilities.gap: The SC-01 event projection covers source-linked canonical geospatial observations, hazards, and work records. Canonical failure, alarm, movement, and external-event projections remain missing and must extend this projection rather than persist copies.
acceptance: Event is a projection, not a new system of record
Source and canonical record linkage are mandatory

capabilities.title: SpatialLayer contract
capabilities.requirement: Define governed layer identity, rendering mode, source dependencies, authorization, health and empty/degraded behavior.
capabilities.gap: The bounded SC-01 server-derived layer registry and per-record parser isolation are delivered; optional Context transport failure is isolated from the canonical geospatial workspace and references.
acceptance: Layer authorization is server-derived
One failed source cannot crash unrelated layers

capabilities.title: Geofence contract
capabilities.requirement: Represent permanent and temporary geofences with source, validity window, canonical subject links, evidence and human-owned disposition.
capabilities.gap: SC-01 gates verification and assessment use on governed source, named owner and explicit current validity; legacy incomplete rows and dependent assessments are quarantined. Later alert policy remains a separate action-bearing slice.
acceptance: Validity and provenance are mandatory
Expired or unverified zones cannot support verified assessments

capabilities.title: SourceHealth contract
capabilities.requirement: Represent connected, live, simulated, not connected, stale, unavailable, malformed, throttled, delayed, conflicting, partial-coverage and clock-skew source states.
capabilities.gap: The normalized SC-01 health contract enforces monotonic checks, non-regressing live observations and a positive freshness interval; later adapters must report these states and timestamps through the governed RPC.
acceptance: Every adapter reports normalized state and observed/check times
Stale and conflicting states are not displayed as live

capabilities.title: ContextSourceAdapter contract
capabilities.requirement: Provide connect or availability, objects, events and health interfaces so demo, public and customer sources can change without rewriting the UI.
capabilities.gap: The interface and canonical adapter are delivered; demo, public and customer-specific adapters are later slices and are not yet proven by one shared runtime conformance suite.
acceptance: Demo, public and customer adapters pass one conformance suite
UI imports only normalized contracts

capabilities.title: Three source classes
capabilities.requirement: Every rendered object and event is exactly one of LIVE EXTERNAL, SIMULATED INDUSTRIAL or CUSTOMER OPERATIONAL.
capabilities.gap: The three-class SC-01 taxonomy is required, immutable and visible; rights state remains separately mutable only through a human-admin revocation/expiry command. Later adapters must register into exactly one class.
acceptance: Class is required and immutable per source record
UI exposes class without relying on color alone

capabilities.title: Source authority and confidence
capabilities.requirement: Object and event views show source system, source class, authority, data quality, confidence, observed time, freshness and named evidence gaps.
capabilities.gap: The governed data exists for geospatial features, but no unified object inspector presents it.
acceptance: Inspector visibly distinguishes observed, simulated and inferred values
Missing evidence is never rendered as zero

capabilities.title: Clock integrity metadata
capabilities.requirement: Every replay-capable source records its time source, estimated offset, synchronization quality and last synchronization check.
externalDependencies: Source clock metadata or measured synchronization
capabilities.gap: Main has timestamps but no cross-source clock-integrity contract.
acceptance: Unknown offset remains unknown
Replay exposes sync quality and prevents unsupported sequence claims

capabilities.title: Camera contract
capabilities.requirement: Represent camera identity, location, coverage area, source, online state, last frame time, retention and access classification without worker identity fields.
externalDependencies: Customer VMS or approved public camera source
capabilities.gap: Main has camera upload controls, not a governed camera-source model.
acceptance: Coverage geometry is source-supplied
Authorization and retention are mandatory
No biometric identity field

capabilities.title: VideoEvidence contract
capabilities.requirement: Represent camera/source, time interval, location, related canonical asset/event, retention expiry, access classification, integrity hash, bookmarks, notes and evidence status on the canonical evidence model.
capabilities.gap: The prototype documents metadata, but main has no video-evidence extension on evidence_items.
acceptance: No parallel evidence table
Hash, source, timestamps, access, annotations and retention survive export

capabilities.title: Full-screen industrial operating picture
capabilities.requirement: Provide a customer-reachable full-screen spatial operating surface with industrial navigation and status language.
capabilities.gap: Main's geospatial panel is a governed record workspace, not a full-screen operating picture.
acceptance: Reachable from canonical navigation
Shows only role-visible tenant data

capabilities.title: Cesium 3D globe
capabilities.requirement: Support an optional performant 3D globe for site, regional and global context without making it the system of record.
capabilities.gap: Main has no Cesium dependency or 3D map runtime.
acceptance: Renderer consumes normalized projections only
No secret or unrestricted customer query runs in the browser

capabilities.title: 2D map
capabilities.requirement: Provide a 2D map view over the same authorized objects, layers, filters, selection and time state as the 3D globe.
externalDependencies: Approved basemap provider or self-hosted tiles
capabilities.gap: Main records GeoJSON but has no map renderer.
acceptance: Verified and draft data are distinguishable
Same filters and selection survive 2D/3D switching

capabilities.title: Shared 2D and 3D state
capabilities.requirement: Switch between 2D and 3D without losing active layers, selected object, time window, scenario or workspace.
capabilities.gap: No spatial-view state exists in main.
acceptance: State preservation browser test
Deep links restore authorized selection and view

capabilities.title: Independent layer toggles
capabilities.requirement: Toggle assets, work, reliability, risk, safety, recovery, project, logistics and external-context layers independently.
capabilities.gap: Main has no map layer runtime.
acceptance: Layer visibility is keyboard accessible
Unauthorized layers never load data

capabilities.title: Per-layer failure isolation
capabilities.requirement: A missing key, unavailable feed, malformed response or failed layer must degrade that layer without taking down the operating picture.
capabilities.gap: No layer runtime exists in main.
acceptance: Fault-injection test for every adapter class
Failed layer remains visible as degraded with last-good timestamp where permitted

capabilities.title: Industrial object inspector
capabilities.requirement: Selecting an object shows canonical identity, operating state, criticality, current event, open and opportunity work, RTS, risks, repeat failures, PoF/RUL context, source authority, confidence and missing evidence when available.
capabilities.gap: Main surfaces these domains separately, not in a spatial inspector.
acceptance: Every displayed claim links to canonical record or is marked unavailable
Risk-sensitive evidence obeys existing read policy

capabilities.title: Inspector workflow handoffs
capabilities.requirement: Expose Open Asset, Assess and Create Decision actions as governed handoffs to canonical pages and draft workflows, never as direct map-side execution.
capabilities.gap: No spatial inspector currently invokes these existing workflows.
acceptance: Actions navigate or create drafts only
Approval and execution stay outside renderer

capabilities.title: Live counters and freshness
capabilities.requirement: Show role-visible object/event counts with observed time, retrieved time, freshness and degraded-state meaning; never show dead or fabricated counters.
capabilities.gap: No Context aggregation endpoint or UI exists.
acceptance: Counts are query-derived
Unavailable sources show unavailable, not zero

capabilities.title: Source-health panel
capabilities.requirement: Show each source's class, normalized health, age, coverage, connection state and last successful check, including customer sources that are explicitly not connected.
capabilities.gap: Main has no unified Context source panel.
acceptance: Not-connected sources cannot emit data
Health is not inferred from object count alone

capabilities.title: Responsive operating surface
capabilities.requirement: Support desktop panels and a usable mobile surface without hiding source, approval or safety state.
capabilities.gap: The main shell is responsive, but no spatial surface has been verified across target sizes.
acceptance: Browser tests at desktop, tablet and 375x812
Controls remain keyboard and touch accessible

capabilities.title: Command search and map presets
capabilities.requirement: Search authorized assets and use curated site, recovery, fire-watch and global presets without enabling arbitrary unsafe commands.
capabilities.gap: Main has navigation and search foundations but no map presets.
acceptance: Search cannot disclose foreign-tenant objects
Presets are curated configuration with tests

capabilities.title: Nearby context and target cycling
capabilities.requirement: Show range-sorted nearby authorized objects within an explicit radius and provide previous/next target navigation.
capabilities.gap: Main does not compute or render nearby context.
acceptance: Radius and units are explicit
Distances derive only from verified source geometry

capabilities.title: Timeline and deterministic replay controls
capabilities.requirement: Provide a time window, play/pause/scrub and event selection surface shared by scenarios and governed investigation replay.
capabilities.gap: Main has no synchronized spatial timeline.
acceptance: Demo replay is deterministic
Investigation replay exposes missing data and clock quality

capabilities.title: Industrial display modes
capabilities.requirement: Support normal, low-light, thermal, high-contrast, all-context and safety display modes with industrial terms and explicit data semantics.
capabilities.gap: Main has no spatial display modes; thermal data itself requires a real source.
acceptance: Mode names do not imply unconnected sensors
High-contrast and reduced-motion checks pass

capabilities.title: Status visualization grammar
capabilities.requirement: Use documented non-color-only cues: pulse for active failure, amber zone for degradation, red polygon for hazard, dashed route for logistics, animated line for dependency, heatmap for repeated failures and halo for critical exposure.
capabilities.gap: The discussion defines the grammar, but neither main evidence nor the prototype ledger proves the full set.
acceptance: Legend explains every cue
Text and shape alternatives cover color and motion limitations

capabilities.title: Fixed assets
capabilities.requirement: Render canonical fixed production, utility and infrastructure assets with verified source geometry and operating context.
capabilities.gap: Canonical data exists; map rendering and complete location coverage do not.
acceptance: Only verified linked geometry renders as customer operational
Missing geometry is disclosed

capabilities.title: Mobile fleet
capabilities.requirement: Render canonical mobile equipment positions, headings and state from an authorized fleet source or clearly labeled simulation.
externalDependencies: Customer fleet system or OEM/dealer endpoint
capabilities.gap: Main has assets and simulated sensor values, not authorized operational positions.
acceptance: Operational positions require authenticated source
Simulation cannot be mistaken for customer GPS

capabilities.title: Field crew zones
capabilities.requirement: Represent crew or work-party zones only when authorized and purpose-limited, without individual tracking or productivity scoring.
externalDependencies: Customer workforce/location policy and approved source
capabilities.gap: Main has crew templates, not governed spatial crew-zone data.
acceptance: Zone data is minimized and purpose-bound
No individual productivity analytics

capabilities.title: Down equipment and recovery clocks
capabilities.requirement: Project canonical down-asset, recovery event, dependency and estimated return-to-service context into the operating picture.
capabilities.gap: Recovery is canonical but not spatially projected.
acceptance: RTS is sourced or explicitly estimated with basis
Map cannot release recovery work

capabilities.title: Work and permit context
capabilities.requirement: Project open work, opportunity work, shutdown work, projects and permits through canonical work identities and authoritative permit state.
externalDependencies: Customer permit-to-work source for authoritative permit state
capabilities.gap: Main does not provide a unified spatial projection or live permit connector.
acceptance: Permit status names its authoritative source
Spatial surface cannot approve, cancel or extend a permit

capabilities.title: Hazard and restricted zones
capabilities.requirement: Render verified hazard, exclusion, outage and restricted-workfront zones with validity, source and evidence.
capabilities.gap: Hazard-zone records exist; outage and temporary restriction semantics need canonical projection and renderer.
acceptance: Unverified or expired zones are visibly non-authoritative
Risk-sensitive access is preserved

capabilities.title: Project, gate and commissioning context
capabilities.requirement: Render project systems, gates, commissioning status and operational-readiness context without creating parallel project records.
canonicalReuse: Sync Develop projects, gates and commissioning
capabilities.gap: Main project data is not spatially projected.
acceptance: Projection links canonical case/project identities
No map-side gate approval

capabilities.title: Road, access and route context
capabilities.requirement: Render verified roads, access routes, closures and logistics routes, with source-supplied geometry and time validity.
capabilities.gap: Governed route records exist; live closure ingestion and renderer do not.
acceptance: No route or travel time is invented
Closure freshness and source are visible

capabilities.title: Parts and logistics movement
capabilities.requirement: Project canonical material, stock, shipment and logistics context, including regional spares, without claiming movement from a simulated traffic feed.
externalDependencies: Customer logistics or shipment source for live movement
capabilities.gap: Regional stock context exists; live shipment movement does not.
acceptance: Stock and movement source classes are distinct
Availability and ETA require source evidence

capabilities.title: Reliability hotspots and condition alerts
capabilities.requirement: Project canonical bad actors, repeat failures, failure clusters, condition alerts and measured trends with evidence and model applicability.
capabilities.gap: Canonical reliability data exists, but spatial clustering and visualization need evidence-backed projections.
acceptance: Cluster significance is not inferred without stated method and evidence
Alert timestamps and source are visible

capabilities.title: PoF and RUL context
capabilities.requirement: Show probability-of-failure and remaining-useful-life outputs only from approved, applicable models with version, inputs, uncertainty and human decision boundary.
canonicalReuse: engineering model registry and applicability envelopes
capabilities.gap: Model governance exists; spatial inspector projection is absent.
acceptance: No PoF/RUL when model is unavailable or out of envelope
Uncertainty and evidence gaps are visible

capabilities.title: Dependency and service-flow context
capabilities.requirement: Render canonical asset dependencies and service flows with evidence-backed direction and validity, not decorative invented links.
capabilities.gap: Relationship governance exists; spatial service-flow projection and completeness evidence are absent.
acceptance: Every edge links canonical assets and evidence
Unknown direction or completeness is disclosed

capabilities.title: Environmental exposure overlays
capabilities.requirement: Combine verified weather, fire, seismic, air-quality and other external context with canonical assets while keeping proximity separate from assessed exposure or causality.
capabilities.gap: Assessment and climate foundations exist; live overlays and adapter evidence do not.
acceptance: Proximity is labeled separately from exposure conclusion
Stale or partial coverage is visible

capabilities.title: Customer system normalization
capabilities.requirement: Normalize CMMS/EAM, historian, fleet, GIS, project-control and permit data behind the same Context contracts without changing renderer semantics.
capabilities.gap: Individual connector foundations exist, but Context conformance and the complete connector set do not.
acceptance: Adapters pass common conformance tests
Tenant, source, freshness and evidence survive normalization

capabilities.title: AEMP 2.0 mixed-fleet lane
capabilities.requirement: Support ISO 15143-3/AEMP 2.0 as an authenticated mixed-fleet contract while showing Caterpillar, Komatsu or dealer sources as not connected until owner-authorized endpoints exist.
capabilities.gap: Roadmap and standard identity exist; no connected AEMP adapter is proved.
acceptance: Endpoint authentication is server-side
Unconnected state is visible and cannot emit operational positions

capabilities.title: NASA EONET hazards
capabilities.requirement: Ingest approved NASA EONET natural-hazard context with provider attribution, timestamps, coverage and health.
externalDependencies: NASA EONET availability and approved terms
capabilities.gap: No EONET adapter exists in main.
acceptance: Terms record approved
Stale and partial coverage are visible
Raw event links to normalized object/event

capabilities.title: NASA FIRMS active fire
capabilities.requirement: Ingest approved NASA FIRMS fire/hotspot context with observed time, uncertainty, attribution, health and explicit distinction between hotspot proximity and asset exposure.
externalDependencies: NASA FIRMS credential/access and approved terms
capabilities.gap: Main can store hazard context but has no FIRMS adapter.
acceptance: Hotspot is not called a confirmed fire impact
Source health and last retrieval are visible

capabilities.title: USGS seismic
capabilities.requirement: Ingest approved USGS seismic events with source time, magnitude data as supplied, spatial uncertainty, attribution and health.
capabilities.gap: No USGS adapter exists in main.
acceptance: Provider payload and normalized projection remain traceable
No unsupported asset-impact claim

capabilities.title: NOAA/NWS and Environment Canada alerts
capabilities.requirement: Ingest approved official weather alerts, including jurisdiction-appropriate fallback, with alert geometry, validity, attribution and source health.
externalDependencies: NOAA/NWS or Environment Canada GeoMet availability and approved terms
capabilities.gap: Main supports weather signals but not these live adapters.
acceptance: Jurisdiction and source are explicit
Expired alerts do not render as active

capabilities.title: Open-Meteo current weather
capabilities.requirement: Ingest current weather from an approved service with location, observed time, retrieval time, units, attribution and health; never synthesize a reading when unavailable.
capabilities.gap: No Open-Meteo adapter exists in main.
acceptance: Units and observation time are preserved
Unavailability is explicit

capabilities.title: Air-quality context
capabilities.requirement: Ingest approved air-quality observations with pollutant, unit, station/model authority, time, coverage and health.
capabilities.gap: No air-quality Context adapter exists in main.
acceptance: Measurement and forecast/model values are distinct
No health or exposure verdict is inferred

capabilities.title: Traffic and access context
capabilities.requirement: Use approved traffic/road sources for contextual access constraints while keeping public traffic motion and cameras separate from operational mine-fleet GPS.
capabilities.gap: Main has access-route evidence but no traffic adapter.
acceptance: Traffic model, public camera and customer GPS have distinct source IDs/classes
No operational location claim from modelled traffic

capabilities.title: Power-grid and infrastructure context
capabilities.requirement: Ingest approved public or customer infrastructure status as contextual dependency evidence without claiming control-system authority.
capabilities.gap: No public grid adapter is present in main.
acceptance: Context source is not represented as SCADA truth
Coverage and delay are visible

capabilities.title: AIS maritime logistics
capabilities.requirement: Use approved AIS data for marine logistics, ports and offshore context with provider terms, position age, coverage and vessel-source caveats.
externalDependencies: AISstream or approved AIS provider credentials and terms
capabilities.gap: No AIS adapter exists in main.
acceptance: Position age and terrestrial/satellite coverage are visible
AIS is not treated as verified asset custody

capabilities.title: Aircraft and airport logistics
capabilities.requirement: Use approved aircraft and airport sources for contextual logistics with source, position age, coverage and terms.
externalDependencies: OpenSky or approved aviation provider and terms
capabilities.gap: No aviation adapter exists in main.
acceptance: Coverage gaps and delayed positions are visible
No customer shipment inference without customer linkage

capabilities.title: GDACS disaster context
capabilities.requirement: Ingest approved GDACS major-event context with provider attribution, event time, severity as supplied, geometry and health.
capabilities.gap: No GDACS adapter exists in main.
acceptance: Provider severity is not rewritten as asset risk
Source record remains traceable

capabilities.title: Public contextual cameras
capabilities.requirement: Display approved public camera media only as LIVE EXTERNAL context with provider terms, location, update state and explicit non-operational authority.
capabilities.gap: No public-camera adapter or media authorization model exists in main.
acceptance: Public camera cannot be linked as customer VMS evidence without governed ingestion
Attribution and update time are visible

capabilities.title: Refresh and cache policy
capabilities.requirement: Use source-appropriate direct refresh or governed caching with rate limits, attribution, allowed retention and stale behavior encoded per source.
capabilities.gap: No Context source registry exists in main.
acceptance: Policy is configuration reviewed per source
Cache never extends beyond approved retention or masks staleness

capabilities.title: Connector health audit
capabilities.requirement: Continuously test unavailable, stale, malformed, throttled, delayed, conflicting, partial-coverage and clock-skew behaviors and report record counts without treating counts as truth.
capabilities.gap: Provider-specific smoke scripts exist elsewhere, but no Context health conformance/audit suite exists.
acceptance: Every failure mode has a deterministic test
Health changes are audited and alertable

capabilities.title: Source rights registry
capabilities.requirement: Record purpose, owner, source class, authentication, attribution, commercial/demo/production approval, caching, redistribution, rate limit, key requirement, retention and review date per source.
capabilities.gap: Main's software inventory is not a data-source rights registry.
acceptance: Every adapter references an approved registry entry
Expired or rejected production approval disables the source

capabilities.title: Persistent demo disclosure
capabilities.requirement: State that industrial site, assets, work, telemetry, risks and scenarios are synthetic while selected public context may be live; show this before and during use.
capabilities.gap: Main has demo data but no Sync Context surface or persistent three-class disclosure.
acceptance: Disclosure appears on entry and inspector/source panel
Automated accessibility test verifies labels

capabilities.title: Synthetic industrial site pack
capabilities.requirement: Provide a clearly fictional site with fixed assets, mobile fleet, utility/infrastructure objects, field zones, roads and dependencies linked through canonical demo identities.
capabilities.gap: Main demo assets exist but not the reviewed Mine North spatial pack.
acceptance: All records are tagged simulated
No fictional value is promoted into customer operational records

capabilities.title: Deterministic telemetry stream
capabilities.requirement: Generate deterministic timestamp, location, operating state, rpm, temperature, vibration, load and health-state demo telemetry through the same adapter contract as customer sources.
capabilities.gap: Main simulates sensor random walks, but the review requires deterministic sales-critical sequences and spatial position/state fields.
acceptance: Same seed and scenario version produce identical sequence
